subject: Renewal: Volume step-ups & blended rates — Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmehealth.com>; procurement@acmehealth.com
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal: Volume step-ups & blended rates — Acme Health

Hi Jordan / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciated the deep dive on usage patterns. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

- Goal: Renew and expand for 2026 with volume step-ups for chat generation and reranking routes; add support for an embeddings-heavy route for search.
- Current annualized token run-rate (from your notes): ~18–25M tokens/month depending on seasonality.
- Acme's target unit cost: aiming for ~$700–$900 per 1M tokens (blended across routes) — you mentioned a wish to get closer to $700 at scale.
- Open questions for pricing: exact monthly committed volumes by quarter (we can model blended rates), whether embeddings route will be on the same SLA and routing policy, and whether you want to add an autoscaling buffer/burst pool.

Attached is a draft proposal and a simple CSV that models tiered step-ups (baseline, +25%, +75%). I've also included a few blended-rate examples at different mix assumptions.

Proposed next steps:
1) Can you confirm a realistic monthly commit range for Q3/Q4 (low/expected/high)? best to give ranges for both chat and embeddings routes.
2) If procurement wants, we can run a 30-day expanded test at the proposed committed level before the renewal effective date.
3) Assuming ranges look good, I'll prepare a redline-ready SOW + pricing appendix and route to legal/procurement.

If you want to jump on a quick 20-min follow-up tomorrow to run through the blended numbers, I'm available 10–12 PT.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: 2026-05-proposal-acmehealth.pdf, acme-pricing-stepups.csv

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmehealth.com>

Date: 2026-05-20T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: Volume step-ups & blended rates — Acme Health

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the files. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Volume ranges (monthly):
  - Chat generation (primary route): low 15M, expected 22M, high 30M
  - Reranking route: low 2M, expected 3.5M, high 5M
  - Embeddings/search: low 1M, expected 2.5M, high 6M

- Budget: We're targeting a blended target around $750/1M tokens. Our procurement team has some flexibility if unit economics are justified by SLA/availability.
- Additional asks: If we add an embeddings route and a higher-cost model for advanced summarization, how do blended rates get calculated? Is there a per-model surcharge or do you offer a blended, weighted rate per 1M tokens?

Procurement (cc'd) — can you confirm process/timeline for SOW review and PO issuance?

Happy to do the quick follow-up tomorrow — 11:00 PT works.

Jordan
Director, Product Ops | Acme Health
jordan.smith@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmehealth.com>; procurement@acmehealth.com
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: Volume step-ups & blended rates — Acme Health

Jordan / Procurement — great, thanks for the ranges and the budget note. Below is a concrete set of options that map to your numbers; I've kept the math conservative and included a blended example. Full spreadsheet attached.

Option A — Conservative step-ups (recommended if you want predictable unit economics):
- Commit tiers (monthly): 0–10M, 10–25M, 25–50M, 50M+
- Unit price per 1M tokens (chat/rerank baseline model): $950 / $800 / $700 / $600
- Embeddings route (separate SKU) discounted at 20% off baseline at each tier (reflects vector store efficiency).

Option B — Aggressive blended pricing (targeting your $750 blended):
- Commit tiers same as above but with steeper discounts: $900 / $750 / $650 / $550
- With your expected mix (22M chat, 3.5M rerank, 2.5M embeddings), blended cost comes to ~$730/1M tokens.

How blended is calculated: weighted by token volume per route and model. If you add a higher-cost model for summarization (e.g., a +30% premium model), that premium is applied to those tokens before computing the weighted average. We can keep embeddings as a separate line on the invoice or include it in a blended appendix — whatever your finance team prefers.

Add-on for new routes/models: There's no fixed per-route surcharge; higher-cost model variants are priced by model SKU (so adding one high-cost model will raise blended cost depending on usage). If you want model-level caps for budget protection, we can add rate-limits and burst tiers in the SOW.

Recommended next steps:
1) I'll publish a redline-ready SOW + pricing appendix (attached one is draft).
2) If procurement is okay, we'll provision a 30-day test at the mid-level commit (25M) so you can validate embeddings route under production traffic.
3) After test, we convert to annual renewal with quarterly step-ups and blended billing.

Docs/links: HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2026-RENEWAL
Attached: acme-pricing-stepups.csv (detailed calculations)

Available 11:00 PT tomorrow for the quick follow-up.

Thanks,
Marissa
